msg: There are two pairs of gnomes, red + brown and green/grey + purple. The gnomes can lead you to up to 9 mushrooms at a time. Click between both colours in each pair until you find the one that is consistently giving a higher value. This will decrease over time and at that point (when it gets to around 2/3) you should switch to the other colour in the pair. Both colours in the pair can yield a low number so just keep pushing through. Also remember to click when in the forest or else you won't collect any mushrooms.
